ETS‑Lindgren Expands RF, EMC, and Wireless Solutions Offerings with Testforce USA
 July 9, 2026
CEDAR PARK, Texas, July 9, 2026 – ETS‑Lindgren has announced a new partnership with Testforce USA, a leading provider of Test and Measurement Solutions. Testforce USA delivers a unique customer experience by connecting innovative engineers with industry-leading instrumentation and systems manufacturers, helping customers develop, validate, and advance next-generation products and technologies. With extensive experience in the test and measurement industry and strong relationships with leading manufacturers, Testforce USA helps customers address today’s engineering challenges by providing solutions that support product innovation, development, testing, and security.
The partnership expands ETS‑Lindgren’s portfolio of RF, wireless, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) Test and Measurement Solutions available throughout Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, and Arkansas (TOLA).
Through this agreement, Testforce USA will provide customers across the TOLA region with access to ETS‑Lindgren’s industry-leading RF, Wireless, and EMC Test Solutions. The collaboration builds upon the long-standing relationship between ETS‑Lindgren and Testforce Canada, extending proven technical expertise and responsive customer support to customers in the United States.
“ETS‑Lindgren is a trusted leader in EMC and RF Shielding Solutions, and we are excited to bring this expanded offering to TOLA customers,” said Jeff Olsen, General Manager of Testforce USA. “This partnership aligns with our mission to help engineers develop innovative products and technologies that advance their businesses and improve the world around us.”
Mark Prchlik, Director, Regional Sales, with ETS‑Lindgren added, “We are pleased to expand the successful partnership we’ve enjoyed with Testforce Canada to Testforce USA. Customers throughout the TOLA region will benefit from Testforce USA’s strong technical expertise and commitment to responsive customer support. This region is home to many of the nation’s leading technology companies, such as Texas Instruments, Dell Technologies, National Instruments, AMD, NXP Semiconductors, Samsung Semiconductor America, Cirrus Logic, Silicon Labs, Motorola Solutions, and AT&T. Together with Testforce USA, we look forward to supporting these organizations and many others with industry-leading RF, Wireless, and EMC Test Solutions.”
Did you know all ETS‑Lindgren factories are certified to the ISO 9001:2015 standard?
This certification encompasses the design and manufacture of Antennas, Absorber, Filters, Positioners, Shielding, and other RF system components. With more than 750 employees and six manufacturing facilities worldwide, ETS‑Lindgren provides comprehensive customer support backed by decades of engineering experience. Customers around the globe rely on the company’s expertise gained from more than 50,000 RF shielded installations. For more information on ETS‑Lindgren’s solutions, view the full line of Test and Measurement Solutions, call +1 512-531-6400, or email [email protected].
About Testforce
Since 1991, Testforce has built its reputation by being Your Experts in Test. As the most trusted technical distributor, our mission is to change how problems are being solved in the test and measurement industry. We provide reliable and personal technical guidance available throughout your search for the right solution for your application. To learn more about Testforce, click here.
About ETS‑Lindgren
ETS‑Lindgren is an international manufacturer of components and systems that measure, shield, and control electromagnetic energy. The company’s products are used for electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), microwave, wireless, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) testing, electromagnetic field (EMF) measurement, and radio frequency (RF) personal safety monitoring.
Headquartered in Cedar Park, Texas, ETS‑Lindgren has manufacturing facilities in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company is a wholly owned subsidiary of ESCO Technologies, a leading supplier of engineered products for growing industrial and commercial markets. ESCO is a New York Stock Exchange listed company (symbol ESE) with headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Additional information about ETS‑Lindgren is available at www.ets-lindgren.com. Follow ETS‑Lindgren on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube. Additional information about ESCO and its subsidiaries is available at www.escotechnologies.com.

 EMC 
ETS‑Lindgren is the global leader in fully integrated, in-house EMC testing solutions—including chambers, instrumentation, and software—that ensure product compliance, reliability, and performance across critical industries by delivering precise, repeatable results in controlled, EMI-mitigated environments.
ETS‑Lindgren is a global leader in providing advanced EMC (Electromagnetic Compatibility) testing solutions that ensure product compliance, reliability, and performance across multiple industries, including automotive, aerospace & defense, medical, and telecommunications. Our solutions encompass a comprehensive range of RF-shielded enclosures, anechoic and reverberation chambers, absorber materials, and components, all designed to create controlled testing environments that mitigate electromagnetic interference (EMI). These solutions are critical for manufacturers and test houses seeking to meet stringent regulatory requirements and industry standards for electromagnetic emissions and immunity.
As a vertically integrated company, ETS‑Lindgren designs and manufactures over 90% of our chamber components, ensuring consistency and quality in our test systems. We are uniquely positioned to provide 100% in-house EMC solutions—including both test chambers and instrumentation systems—while managing all mechanical, electrical, and RF interfaces. This streamlined, vendor-free approach reduces risk and complexity for our customers. Our EMC portfolio includes RF-shielded doors, power line filters, connector panels, customized absorber materials, and advanced positioning systems such as multi-axis positioners and turntables, all engineered for seamless integration and optimized chamber performance.
ETS‑Lindgren’s EMC solutions are further enhanced by software and instrumentation, including TILE!™ (Totally Integrated Laboratory Environment) Software, which automates test procedures and delivers comprehensive data analysis. Additionally, VisionTRX automates visual EUT monitoring during immunity tests, eliminating the need for manual observation. Our chambers are equipped with industry-leading EMI receivers, emission antennas, and high-performance field generation systems to ensure precise, repeatable results. With decades of experience, unmatched system integration capabilities, and a commitment to innovation, ETS‑Lindgren helps customers bring compliant, high-performance products to market—faster and with greater confidence.

 Conducted & Radiated Immunity 
Electronic systems must perform reliably when exposed to strong electromagnetic fields. ETS‑Lindgren immunity solutions generate precise RF stress environments to validate product robustness and compliance.
ETS‑Lindgren offers comprehensive immunity test solutions to evaluate electronic devices’ resilience against electromagnetic interference (EMI) and ensure compliance with industry standards such as IEC 61000-4-3, MIL-STD-461, ISO-11451-x, ISO-11452-x, and RTCA DO-160. Our solutions include fully anechoic and semi-anechoic chambers, reverberation chambers, and GTEM cells designed to create controlled environments for precise immunity testing. These chambers are equipped with high-performance RF shielding, absorbers, and precision positioning positions to ensure accurate and repeatable results in electromagnetic susceptibility assessments.
To support immunity testing, ETS‑Lindgren provides a full range of specialized equipment, including broadband antennas, RF power amplifiers, field probes, and automated test software. Our EMCenter™ modular test system integrates multiple components into a streamlined testing platform, enhancing efficiency and automation. The TILE!™ software simplifies test setup, execution, and data analysis, allowing users to conduct rigorous immunity testing with minimal manual intervention when using our VisionTRX software. With advanced positioning systems, turntables, and mast-mounted antenna setups, ETS‑Lindgren ensures precise exposure of the Device Under Test (DUT) to electromagnetic fields.
Beyond equipment and chamber solutions, ETS‑Lindgren provides end-to-end system integration, calibration, and technical support to help manufacturers achieve compliance and improve product reliability. Our team of experts assists with chamber design, custom test configurations, and performance verification, ensuring that immunity tests meet the most stringent regulatory requirements. By offering cutting-edge immunity testing solutions, ETS‑Lindgren enables industries such as automotive, aerospace, medical, and consumer electronics to develop products that perform reliably in real-world electromagnetic environments.

 Conducted & Radiated Emissions 
ETS‑Lindgren delivers complete EMC test systems to measure conducted and radiated emissions to global regulatory standards. Chambers, antennas, receivers, and software work together to identify and control unwanted RF energy.
ETS‑Lindgren provides industry-leading solutions for EMC radiated emissions testing, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards such as CISPR, FCC, MIL-STD, and IEC. Our solutions include fully anechoic and semi-anechoic chambers, designed to create controlled test environments that accurately measure electromagnetic interference (EMI) emitted by electronic devices. These chambers are equipped with high-performance RF shielding, ferrite tile, and hybrid absorber materials that minimize unwanted reflections and external interference, providing highly precise emission measurements.
In addition to chamber solutions, ETS‑Lindgren offers a complete range of testing equipment, including broadband antennas, EMI receivers, preamplifiers, and test automation software. Our cutting-edge TILE!™ software streamlines conducted and radiated emissions testing by automating data collection, analysis, and reporting, enhancing efficiency and repeatability in compliance testing. Advanced positioning systems, such as turntables and multi-axis positioners, further optimize the testing process by allowing seamless DUT (Device Under Test) orientation for accurate emissions characterization.
ETS‑Lindgren’s expertise extends beyond hardware solutions, offering turnkey system integration, calibration, and ongoing support to ensure consistent, repeatable results for regulatory approvals. Our team of engineers assists with chamber design, shielding effectiveness verification, and customized test setups to meet specific industry requirements. By providing end-to-end solutions for conducted and radiated emissions testing, ETS‑Lindgren helps manufacturers achieve compliance quickly and efficiently, reducing time-to-market for new electronic products.

 Calibration Services 
Accurate EMC testing depends on traceable calibration across the entire measurement chain. ETS‑Lindgren calibrates antennas, receivers, probes, and chambers to ensure regulatory-grade measurement confidence.
ETS‑Lindgren provides comprehensive calibration services for EMC (Electromagnetic Compatibility) equipment, ensuring accurate and reliable performance for compliance and testing applications. Our calibration services cover a wide range of critical EMC testing components, including antennas, field probes, power meters, LISNs (Line Impedance Stabilization Networks), and other RF measurement equipment. By maintaining precise calibration, ETS‑Lindgren helps customers meet industry standards such as CISPR, MIL-STD, IEC, ISO, and ANSI, ensuring our test equipment remains within required tolerances for regulatory compliance.
With state-of-the-art calibration facilities and highly trained technicians, ETS‑Lindgren performs both accredited and non-accredited calibrations to suit various industry needs. Our facilities adhere to ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation requirements, ensuring traceability to national and international measurement standards. Utilizing advanced measurement techniques and automated calibration systems, ETS‑Lindgren provides highly accurate calibrations, reducing measurement uncertainty and improving test repeatability.
ETS‑Lindgren’s calibration services are designed to minimize downtime and maximize operational efficiency for customers. They offer on-site and laboratory calibration options, providing flexibility for companies that require immediate service or scheduled maintenance. Additionally, our calibration services include detailed documentation and certification, ensuring compliance with quality management systems. With a commitment to precision and reliability, ETS‑Lindgren’s calibration services help organizations maintain the integrity of our EMC testing processes, ensuring accurate measurements for product validation and regulatory approval.
